tool_input.command:
cd <repo>
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
docs: scope the zero-agent-authority claim, fix a stale prfaq.tex disclaimer

Two findings from the full-diff code-reviewer pass:

1. docs/ARCHITECTURE.md's "Zero agent authority" bullet claimed "every
   action requires a GPG-signed instruction" -- overclaiming past what
   the code guarantees. internal/daemon/handler.go's OnNewMail still
   creates a mission record or starts a pipeline goroutine on trust+x
   permission alone, no signed command involved -- it just happens that
   nothing downstream executes with zero commands loaded (StubPlanner
   fails at planning). Scoped the invariant to command execution and
   named the residual gap explicitly, pointing at beadle-tl6.

2. prfaq.tex's "What's real today" disclaimer still said GPG
   command-signing enforcement "is not yet built at all" -- stale since
   DES-034/035 shipped. Corrected to describe the actual current state.

Also reverted "recipe" terminology introduced earlier this branch back
to "command file" in prfaq.tex and ARCHITECTURE.md, matching the
codebase's actual vocabulary -- a second synonym for the same thing
serves no one.
EOF
)"
